tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Centered progress path with offset illustration zones. Mascot and illustration behavior make progress feel social rather than abstract.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Expressive display type may carry identity; quieter utility type must retain operational clarity. Type, controls, and shapes share approachable weight and clear touch affordance.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Success, streak, and correction states visibly change the learner's emotional momentum.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Playfulness remains subordinate to the next learning action.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Playful lesson path with a character-led progress moment and one obvious action. Illustration must teach, motivate, or report state; decorative filler does not qualify.
